name: tris-island-aerial
js: (() => new Promise((res) => { const i = window.__CITY_APP.renderer.info, out = []; const f = () => { out.push(i.render.triangles); if (out.length < 60) requestAnimationFrame(f); else { const nz = out.filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => a - b); res({ frames: out.length, nonzero: nz.length, max: nz[nz.length - 1] || 0, median: nz[nz.length >> 1] || 0, calls: i.render.drawCalls }); } }; requestAnimationFrame(f); }))()
